tagline: 理光数码相机，2001 年发布
description: 理光于2001年推出的数码相机。配备F:2.8-3.8, 6 glass elements in 5 groups。快门速度Still: 4,2,1-1/1000sec. (mechanical shutter), Motion: 1/30-1/4000sec. (electronic shutter)。感光度AUTO/Selectable ISO(Equivalent to 200/400)。

specs.变焦: Optical 2x zoom, f=5.9-11.8mm(38-76mm in 35mm camera format), Digital 2x zoom
specs.尺寸: 116.8 x 29.5 x 53.8mm, 4.6 x 1.2 x 2.1 inch (excluding projections)
specs.英文简介: The Ricoh Caplio RR10 has been introduced by Ricoh in 2001.
